name: Maybelline Baby Skin Instant Pore Eraser Primer | Matte & Poreless Makeup Primer | Lightweight Pore-Blurring Formula | 22 ml
description:
Create a smooth and flawless base for your makeup with Maybelline Baby Skin Instant Pore Eraser Primer. This lightweight and breathable primer helps blur the appearance of pores and leaves the skin with a soft, smooth, and matte-looking finish. Its easy-to-apply formula creates an ideal base before foundation and makeup application while helping reduce the appearance of excess shine.

Key Features
Helps blur the appearance of pores
Creates a smooth and matte-looking makeup base
Lightweight and breathable cream formula
Helps provide a soft, baby-smooth skin appearance
Prepares the skin for foundation and makeup application
Helps makeup apply more smoothly
Helps control the appearance of excess shine
Non-comedogenic formula
Fragrance-free formula
Suitable for everyday makeup routines

Finish: Matte and Poreless-Looking

How to Use
Start with clean and moisturized skin
Take a small amount of primer
Apply evenly to the face, focusing on areas with visible pores
Gently blend using your fingertips
Allow the primer to settle before applying foundation or other makeup products

Material / Composition
Cream-Based Primer Formula
Pore-Blurring Ingredients
Skin-Smoothing Ingredients
Lightweight Makeup Base
